subject: Monitoring wiring & escalation setup for Opsly integration
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-08-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Monitoring wiring & escalation setup for Opsly integration

Hi Jordan / Opsly team,

Thanks again for partnering with us for the telemetry integration. To make the implementation run smoothly on our side, can you confirm the following items so the CS/SRE handoff is ready on Day 1?

- Dashboard list: which high-level dashboards (health, latency, error-by-endpoint, inference-cost) do you want Redwood to provision automatically vs. maintain as view-only?
- Tracing hooks: preferred tracer (OTel collector endpoint / sampling rate / span attributes) and whether you plan to inject your own correlation IDs.
- Error taxonomy: canonical error classes that should surface in alerts (e.g., model-timeout, kv-cache-miss, decoding-error).
- Alert routing: primary on-call contact and escalation tiering (pager, email, severity mapping).
- Runbooks: initial owners for incident runbooks and a preferred storage location (Drive link or your internal Confluence).

I've attached an initial telemetry matrix (opsly-telemetry-matrix.xlsx) that maps our recommended signals to dashboards and alerts — please review and mark preferred ownership. Goal: finalize ownership and alert thresholds by EOD Aug 11 so we can schedule a 30-min wiring session the week of Aug 16.

Attachments: opsly-telemetry-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

From: Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@opsly.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, opsly-support@opsly.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-08-09T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Monitoring wiring & escalation setup for Opsly integration

Laura — thanks for the clear checklist. Quick answers from our side:

- Dashboards: We'd like Redwood to provision the baseline health + latency dashboards as editable views. Error-by-endpoint can be a read-only view for our SREs.
- Tracing: We'll stream via an OTel collector; sampling default 1% for production traces, 10% for A/B testing. We'll add a correlation_id header (x-opsly-cid) at the load balancer.
- Error taxonomy: We'll align with your suggested classes but add a "third-party-timeout" bucket for our downstreams.
- Alert routing: primary on-call is opsly-oncall@opsly.com (PagerDuty). Severity mapping: Sev1 = system outage, Sev2 = degradations, Sev3 = single-user errors.
- Runbooks: we'll store runbooks in this shared Drive folder (see link below); initial owners: Jordan Hayes (SRE lead) and Priya Natarajan (Platform).

I'll review the attached matrix and flag rows where we need threshold adjustments. Would appreciate it if Ben could outline the recommended escalation matrix from Redwood's side — specifically how we want to route Sev2s between CS and SRE.

Drive link: https://drive.opsly.com/shared/integration-redwood

Cheers,
Jordan Hayes
Head of Site Reliability
Opsly Inc.
jordan.hayes@opsly.com

Jordan / team — attaching Redwood's proposed escalation-matrix.pdf with routing rules. High-level notes:

- Sev1 (platform down): immediate PagerDuty page to Redwood SRE team + Opsly oncall (dual page). Runbook: "service-outage-steps" — failover to smaller model and trigger incident bridge.
- Sev2 (performance degradation): initial alert to Redwood SRE slack channel and Opsly email; if not acknowledged in 15m, page Opsly oncall. CS (Laura) gets an informational alert for customer communication when degradation affects >10% requests.
- Sev3 (user-specific errors): routed to CS (Laura) for investigation; auto-retries enabled for transient decoding errors.

Runbook excerpt (for Sev2):
1) Triage: confirm scope via dashboard (latency-by-region) and traces (sampled spans).
2) Mitigation: enable burst capacity on Dedicated pools or reduce token_limit for non-critical routes.
3) Postmortem owner: Redwood SRE unless root cause is customer integration layer.

Attachments: escalation-matrix.pdf (mapping + contact list)

Ben Carter
